app.name: TARDIS
app.fullName: TARDIS (TVOC API & Recording Data Intelligence System) Platform
app.description: TARDIS is a comprehensive operations monitoring and management platform for financial institutions, covering Trader Voice (TV) communications infrastructure, Ops Compliance (OC) compliance monitoring, and Administration functions.

roles.Doctor: Super-admin with access to all modules and administration features
roles.TV Admin: Tradervoice administrator with full TV module access
roles.TV Operations: Tradervoice operations team with standard TV access
roles.TV GETEC: Specialized role limited to GETEC monitoring within the TV module
roles.OC Admin: OpsCompliance administrator with full OC module access
roles.OC Analyst: OpsCompliance analyst with standard OC access

modules.name: Trader Voice (TV)
modules.description: Monitors and manages the Trader Voice telecommunications infrastructure for financial trading floors. This module tracks voice recording compliance, system health, connection counts, cloud telephony, messaging services, and billing across all global regions (AMER, EMEA, APAC).

modules.name: Ops Compliance (OC)
modules.description: Oversees compliance monitoring for operations teams. Tracks communications compliance, recording archiving, message counts, device management, secret management via Thycotic, activity logs, and reconciliation reports across the organization.

modules.name: Administration
modules.description: Platform administration including user profile management, system settings, API key management, activity logging, and data reconciliation/refetching tools. Restricted to Doctors (super-admins).

pages.title: Trader Voice Main Dashboard
pages.description: The central Trader Voice operations dashboard showing a real-time overview of all TV infrastructure health. Displays server status across all regions, user connection counts by city and country, active alerts, trader version distribution, login activity, and regional performance metrics.

charts.name: Users Per Country
charts.description: Visualizes the geographic distribution of Trader Voice users across countries. The map highlights countries with active traders; the donut chart shows percentage distribution by region.

charts.name: 30-Day Login Users Trend
charts.description: Shows the daily count of logged-in traders over the past 30 days. Useful for identifying usage trends, unusual spikes, or drops that might indicate systemic issues.

charts.name: Login By Region
charts.description: Breaks down login counts by geographic region (AMER, EMEA, APAC) to compare regional activity levels.

charts.name: Server Status
charts.description: Color-coded (green/yellow/red) health status cards for all Trader Voice servers grouped by region.

tables.name: Recent Alerts
tables.description: Lists the most recent system alerts across all TV infrastructure, including severity, affected system, message, and timestamp. Helps operations teams quickly identify and respond to incidents.

tables.name: Missing Recordings
tables.description: Tables showing connections with missing voice recordings, important for compliance verification.

workflows: Monitor overall system health at a glance

pages.title: TV Daily Checks
pages.description: Structured daily health check workflow for Tradervoice systems. Operations teams run through a comprehensive checklist covering Cloud9 service status, Cohesity connector health, SMS/call tables, shipping lines, IP address impedance, and ServiceNow ticket hygiene for each region (AMER, EMEA, APAC). Checklist completion is tracked and timestamped.

charts.name: Cloud9 Service Status
charts.description: Service-specific health indicators for Cloud9 platform components.

tables.name: AMER Checklist
tables.description: Step-by-step compliance checklist for the Americas region. Each item can be checked off with notes.

tables.name: EMEA Checklist
tables.description: Daily checks for Europe, Middle East, and Africa region.

tables.name: APAC Checklist
tables.description: Daily checks for Asia-Pacific region.

tables.name: SMS Table
tables.description: Current SMS delivery status and counts from the Trader Voice system.

tables.name: Calls Table
tables.description: Active and recent call records with status, duration, and participant details.

tables.name: Shipping Lines Table
tables.description: Status of dedicated shipping line connections used for high-priority trading communication.

workflows: Verify all regional checklists are signed off
Identify and escalate any failing health checks
Log incidents in ServiceNow for failing items

pages.title: AccSys — Trader Voice MRL Console
pages.description: The AccSys page for Trader Voice tracks Must Record List (MRLs) for traders. An MRL is a regulatory requirement that permits a trader to use mobile voice channels. This page shows which traders have active MRLs, which are pending approval, who is currently on block leave, and a geographic breakdown of MRLs by office location. Navigate here to check active MRL counts, pending MRLs, or to investigate specific traders. The sidebar label is 'AccSys' under the Trader Voice menu.
kpis: MRL Quick Check — overall RAG status (Red/Amber/Green) indicating whether MRL data is healthy
Total Users — total number of traders in the AccSys system
Active MRLs — count of traders with a currently active Mobile Recording Licence
Pending MRLs — count of traders whose MRL application is awaiting approval

tables.name: Active MRL Table
tables.description: Full list of traders with active MRLs. Columns include: NTID, Last Name, First Name, Email, Block Leave status, Country, City, Building, GRBU (business unit), MRL Status, Mobile Number, CHNL ACC NAME, MVOICE, TVOICE, VOICE.

tables.name: Pending MRL Table
tables.description: Traders whose MRL is submitted but not yet approved. Requires follow-up with the approvals team.

tables.name: Block Leave In Progress Table
tables.description: Traders currently on block leave. Recording obligations are paused during block leave.

charts.name: MRLs By Location
charts.description: Progress bars showing MRL coverage per office location.

charts.name: Service Coverage Map
charts.description: Geographic map showing which regions have active MRL coverage.

charts.name: Total Channel Count
charts.description: Breakdown of MVOICE, TVOICE, and VOICE channel assignments across the trader population.

workflows: Check how many traders have active MRLs
Review MRL coverage by office location

pages.title: TV ServiceNow Dashboard
pages.description: Integration dashboard showing ServiceNow ITSM data for Trader Voice. Displays open incidents, change requests, problem records, and SLA compliance metrics directly from the ServiceNow platform relevant to TV infrastructure.

charts.name: Incident Trend by Priority
charts.description: Shows the volume of P1/P2/P3 incidents over time for TV systems.

charts.name: SLA Compliance
charts.description: Displays percentage of incidents resolved within SLA targets.

tables.name: Open Incidents
tables.description: Active ServiceNow incidents related to Trader Voice infrastructure, with priority, assignment, and age.

tables.name: Recent Changes
tables.description: Recent change requests that may affect TV systems.

pages.title: Cloud9 Monitoring
pages.description: Monitors the Cloud9 trading communication platform — a cloud-based telephony solution used by traders. Shows user activity, session counts, call quality metrics, service availability, and connection health by region.

charts.name: Cloud9 Session Count
charts.description: Real-time and historical count of active Cloud9 sessions.

charts.name: Regional Distribution
charts.description: Breakdown of Cloud9 users across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

tables.name: Active Sessions
tables.description: Current active Cloud9 user sessions with username, region, duration, and quality indicators.

pages.title: ASC Voice Insights
pages.description: Analytics and insights from the ASC voice recording platform that records MS Teams Voice calls. Shows recording capture rates, storage utilization, call analytics, compliance coverage metrics, and recording quality data. Essential for demonstrating regulatory recording compliance.

charts.name: Recording Capture Rate
charts.description: Percentage of required calls that were successfully recorded over time.

charts.name: Storage Utilization
charts.description: Voice recording storage consumption trends.

pages.title: Twilio Dashboard
pages.description: Monitors Twilio communication services integrated with the Trader Voice platform. Tracks SMS delivery rates, call completion rates, error logs, cost metrics, and usage patterns across Twilio numbers and services.

pages.title: Cohesity ASP
pages.description: Monitoring dashboard for Cohesity ASP (Alta Storage Protection) — the backup and archiving infrastructure for voice recordings. Shows backup job status, archive health, recovery point objectives (RPO), and storage capacity.

pages.title: TV Activity Log
pages.description: Comprehensive activity log for all Trader Voice module events and user actions. Allows operations teams to audit changes, track who did what, and investigate historical incidents. Supports filtering by date range, user, action type, and severity.

tables.name: Activity Log Table
tables.description: Chronological log of all TV platform activities including user actions, system events, and automated jobs. Columns include timestamp, user, action, target, status, and notes.

workflows: Audit user actions on the TV platform
Review historical activity for incident investigation

pages.title: TV Analytics Dashboard
pages.description: Advanced analytics dashboard for Trader Voice platform performance. Provides deep-dive metrics, trend analysis, comparative analytics across regions and time periods, and exportable reports for management reporting.

charts.name: Long-term Trend Charts
charts.description: Historical trend lines for key TV metrics over weeks/months.

charts.name: Regional Comparison
charts.description: Side-by-side comparison of metrics across AMER, EMEA, and APAC.

pages.title: TV Tools
pages.description: Utility tools for Trader Voice operations. Includes diagnostic tools, bulk operations, data export utilities, manual trigger functions, and operational shortcuts to streamline common TV management tasks.

pages.title: TeleMessage
pages.description: [DEPRICATED] Monitors TeleMessage — a secure mobile messaging and call archiving service used for regulatory compliance. Tracks message capture rates, user enrollment, archiving status, and compliance reporting. Restricted to Doctor role only.

pages.title: Cloud9 Billing
pages.description: Billing and cost management dashboard for Cloud9 services. Shows monthly costs, per-user billing, cost trends, budget vs actual comparisons, and billing anomaly detection.

charts.name: Monthly Cost Trend
charts.description: Month-over-month Cloud9 billing trends.

charts.name: Cost Breakdown
charts.description: Cost distribution by service type, region, and user segment.

pages.title: MRL Incident / Service Entry Reporting
pages.description: Service Entry Reporting (SER) dashboard for MRL (Maintenance Request Log) incidents. Teams log, track, and manage maintenance requests and service entries. Supports creating new entries, viewing status progression, and generating compliance reports.

tables.name: Service Entries Table
tables.description: All MRL service entries with columns for entry ID, description, requester, status (Open/In-Progress/Closed), priority, dates, and resolution notes.

pages.title: Maintenance Calendar
pages.description: Calendar view of all planned and completed maintenance windows, outages, and change activities. Allows teams to schedule maintenance, avoid conflicts, and communicate planned downtime to stakeholders.

pages.title: Dubber Call Recording
pages.description: Monitoring dashboard for Dubber — a cloud-based call recording and voice intelligence platform. Tracks recording capture compliance, playback access, storage, transcription accuracy, and user enrollment.

pages.title: Leapxpert (Global)
pages.description: Monitors Leapxpert — a compliant messaging and communication capture platform for financial services. Tracks message capture rates, user enrollment, channel coverage for SMS and iMessage, and archiving compliance globally.

pages.title: Leapxpert Singapore
pages.description: Singapore-specific Leapxpert monitoring dashboard. Focuses on SGP regional message compliance for SMS and iMessage, local user enrollment, and archiving status.

pages.title: Leapxpert EMEA
pages.description: EMEA (Europe, Middle East, Africa) regional Leapxpert monitoring. Tracks GDPR-compliant archiving, EMEA user enrollment, and regional SMS and iMessage capture compliance.

pages.title: GETEC Monitoring
pages.description: Monitoring dashboard dedicated to GETEC technology systems integrated with Trader Voice. Provides health metrics, connection status, and operational data for GETEC components.

pages.title: TV Reconciliation
pages.description: Data reconciliation dashboard for Trader Voice that identifies discrepancies between various data sources — AccSys, Cloud9, ASC, and the TARDIS platform. Flags mismatches and provides resolution workflows.

tables.name: Discrepancy Report
tables.description: Lists data mismatches between TV platform data sources, with severity classification and recommended resolution steps.

pages.title: TV Voice Counts
pages.description: Detailed voice usage count tracking dashboard. Shows real-time and historical counts of voice sessions, calls, active handsets, and licensed seats vs actual usage to support capacity planning and licensing compliance.

charts.name: Voice Count Trend
charts.description: Historical trend of voice handset and session counts over time.

pages.title: MRL Report & Reconciliation
pages.description: Combined reporting and reconciliation dashboard for MRL (Must Record List) data. Provides summary reports, trend analysis, and data reconciliation between MRL entries and actual service records.

pages.title: OpsCompliance Main Dashboard
pages.description: Central OpsCompliance operations overview. Displays compliance health scores, recording coverage metrics, system status across compliance tools (MS Teams ASC, Cohesity, Leapxpert, Arctera), and critical compliance alerts requiring immediate attention.

charts.name: Compliance Coverage Score
charts.description: Overall compliance coverage percentage across all monitored communication channels.

charts.name: Recording Status by System
charts.description: Recording success/failure breakdown per compliance system.

pages.title: AccSys — Ops Compliance MRL Console
pages.description: The AccSys page for Ops Compliance tracks Mobile Recording Licences (MRLs) for the compliance-monitored user population. Similar to the TV AccSys page but scoped to OC-managed staff. Shows active MRLs, pending MRLs, temporary MRLs, block leave status, joiners and movers, and leavers. Also includes a Consolidated Non-MRL User Access view for users who have voice channel access without a valid MRL — a compliance risk. The sidebar label is 'AccSys' under the Ops Compliance menu.
kpis: Overall MRL Stats — summary of active, pending, and temporary MRL counts for the OC user population

tables.name: Active MRL Table
tables.description: Users with a currently active MRL under Ops Compliance.

tables.name: Pending MRL Table
tables.description: Users awaiting MRL approval.

tables.name: AC Temp MRL Table
tables.description: Users on a temporary MRL — issued under exceptional circumstances pending full approval.

tables.name: Block Leave In Progress
tables.description: OC users currently on block leave.

tables.name: Consolidated Non-MRL User Access
tables.description: Users who have voice channel access but no valid MRL. This is a compliance risk and requires remediation.

tables.name: Joiner & Movers Table
tables.description: New joiners and staff who changed role or desk — MRL action may be required.

tables.name: Leavers Table
tables.description: Staff who have left — tracks MRL deactivation and regulatory data retention requirements.

workflows: Review active and pending MRLs for OC staff
Identify non-MRL users with voice access (compliance risk)
Process MRL actions for joiners, movers, and leavers

pages.title: OC ServiceNow
pages.description: ServiceNow integration for Ops Compliance showing compliance-related incidents, change requests, and problem records. Focuses on compliance system outages, remediation tasks, and regulatory-related tickets.

pages.title: MS Teams ASC Monitoring
pages.description: Monitors Microsoft Teams call and meeting recording via the ASC platform. Tracks capture rates for MS Teams communications, user enrollment status, compliance coverage, and recording quality metrics.

pages.title: Arctera Merge1
pages.description: Tracks the Arctera archiving platform's Merge1 and consolidation operations. Monitors email and communication archive merges, data integrity checks, deduplication rates, and archive health.

pages.title: OC TeleMessage
pages.description: Ops Compliance view of TeleMessage archiving. Doctor-only access. Tracks secure mobile message compliance capture rates and archiving status for OC-managed users.

pages.title: OC Activity Log
pages.description: Activity log for all Ops Compliance module events. Records changes, workflow completions, alert responses, and user actions within the OC module for audit and compliance purposes.

pages.title: Mobile Device Management
pages.description: MDM dashboard showing enrolled mobile devices, compliance status, policy enforcement, application management, and device health. Critical for tracking trader mobile devices used for compliant communication.

tables.name: Device Inventory
tables.description: All enrolled mobile devices with owner, OS version, compliance status, last check-in time, and policy compliance indicators.

pages.title: Thycotic Device Status
pages.description: Intune reporting of MRL user device details and the installation status of Thycotic on those devices. Some users may have multiple devices. Displays a paginated table of all enrolled devices showing Device Name, UPN (user email), Device Platform (e.g. Windows 10), App Version, Installation Status (Installed / Not Installed / Failed / Pending), Intune Device ID, and Last Modified Time. Separate summary cards show total device count and installation status breakdown across all devices.

tables.name: Thycotic Device Status Table
tables.description: Paginated list of all MRL user devices reported via Intune. Columns: Device Name, UPN, Device Platform, App Version, Status (Installed / Not Installed / Install Pending / Failed), Intune Device ID, Last Modified Time. Supports search by device name or UPN and configurable page size (10/20/30/50/100). Exportable to CSV.

workflows: Search for a specific device or user by UPN in the search box
Change page size using the Show dropdown to see more results at once
Export the full device list to CSV using the Export CSV button
Use the installation status column to identify devices where Thycotic is not yet installed or has failed

faqs.question: What does the Thycotic Device Status page show?
faqs.answer: It shows Intune-reported device records for MRL users, including whether the Thycotic application is installed on each device. One user can appear multiple times if they have multiple enrolled devices.

faqs.question: Why does a user appear more than once?
faqs.answer: Some MRL users have multiple enrolled devices (e.g. a desktop and a laptop). Each device is listed as a separate row.

pages.title: OC Leapxpert
pages.description: Ops Compliance view of Leapxpert compliant messaging. Tracks OC-specific user enrollment, message archiving compliance, and channel coverage for OpsCompliance team users.

pages.title: Arctera Monitoring
pages.description: Monitors the Arctera (formerly Veritas Enterprise Vault) archiving platform. Tracks archive health, retention policy compliance, data growth, and retrieval performance for communications archiving.

pages.title: OC Message Counts
pages.description: Detailed message count analytics across all compliance-monitored communication channels. Shows volume trends by channel (voice, email, instant messaging, mobile), compliance coverage, and identifies gaps in message capture.

charts.name: Message Volume by Channel
charts.description: Daily/weekly message volumes broken down by channel type.

pages.title: OC Calendar
pages.description: Compliance calendar showing scheduled compliance reviews, regulatory deadlines, audit dates, system maintenance windows, and recurring OC tasks with deadline tracking.

pages.title: OC Daily Checks
pages.description: Daily compliance health check workflow for the OpsCompliance team. Structured checklist covering all compliance system health checks, archiving status reviews, and compliance metric verification.

pages.title: OC MRL Report & Reconciliation
pages.description: MRL report and reconciliation specifically for OpsCompliance. Generates compliance-focused MRL reports and reconciles OC data sources.

pages.title: User Profile Management
pages.description: User management interface for all TARDIS platform users. Allows creating, editing, deactivating user accounts, assigning roles, and managing user permissions. Full CRUD operations on user profiles.

tables.name: User Directory
tables.description: Complete list of all TARDIS users with name, email, role, status (active/inactive), and last login. Supports search and filtering.

workflows: Edit existing user roles and details

pages.title: Admin Global Settings
pages.description: Global platform settings including system configuration, integration credentials, notification settings, alert thresholds, data retention policies, and application-wide preferences.

pages.title: TV Admin Settings
pages.description: Trader Voice module-specific administrative settings. Configure TV integration endpoints, alert thresholds, notification rules, and TV-specific operational parameters.

pages.title: OC Admin Settings
pages.description: OpsCompliance module-specific administrative settings. Configure OC integration endpoints, compliance thresholds, archiving rules, and OC-specific operational parameters.

pages.title: API Key Management
pages.description: Manage API keys for TARDIS platform integrations. Create, rotate, revoke, and monitor API keys used by external services and integrations to authenticate with the TARDIS backend.

tables.name: API Keys Table
tables.description: All active/inactive API keys with name, permissions scope, creation date, last used, and expiry.

workflows: Generate new API keys for integrations

pages.title: Admin Activity Log
pages.description: Comprehensive platform-wide activity audit log. Records all administrative actions including user management changes, settings updates, API key operations, and system configuration changes.

pages.title: Data Reconciler
pages.description: System data reconciliation tool that compares and synchronizes data between TARDIS and its upstream data sources. Identifies discrepancies, runs automated reconciliation jobs, and produces reconciliation reports.

pages.title: Data Refetcher
pages.description: Tool to re-fetch and refresh data from external sources when cached or stored data may be stale. Allows targeted re-pull of specific data sets without full system refresh.

navigation.description: TARDIS uses role-based navigation. The sidebar shows only modules the current user has access to.

commonWorkflows.title: Morning Daily Check Routine
steps: 1. Open TV Daily Checks (/tardis-tv-dailychecks) - complete AMER/EMEA/APAC checklists
2. Review TV Main Dashboard (/tardis-tv-main) for overnight alerts
3. Check ServiceNow (/tardis-tv-servicenow) for new critical incidents
4. Open OC Daily Checks (/tardis-oc-dailychecks) - complete OC checklist

commonWorkflows.title: Incident Response Workflow
steps: 2. Navigate to affected system dashboard for details
4. Log new MRL incident if needed at /mrl-incident

commonWorkflows.title: New User Onboarding
steps: 3. Fill in details and assign role

commonWorkflows.title: Compliance Review
steps: 1. Check OC Main Dashboard for compliance score

faq.question: How do I check if Cloud9 Voice Recording is working?
faq.answer: Navigate to TV Main Dashboard (/tardis-tv-main) to see high-level status of their API endpoints and services, then go to Cloud9 (/tardis-tv-cloud9) for more details and regional specific services.

faq.question: Where do I manage users?
faq.answer: Go to User Profile Management at /tardis-admin-userprofile. This requires Doctor (admin) access.

faq.question: How do I see compliance scores?
faq.answer: The Ops Compliance Main Dashboard (/tardis-oc-main) shows the overall compliance score. For channel-specific compliance, check Message Counts (/tardis-oc-messagecounts).

faq.question: Where can I log a new incident or maintenance request?
faq.answer: Use the MRL Incident page at /mrl-incident to log service entries and maintenance requests.

faq.question: How do I rotate an API key?
faq.answer: Navigate to API Key Management at /tardis-admin-apikey, find the key, and use the rotate/regenerate option. Requires Doctor role.

faq.question: What is the daily check process?
faq.answer: Each morning, a predefined ste of tests are completed to assure systems are all working as expected. Trader Voice complete the TV Daily Checks (/tardis-tv-dailychecks) covering AMER, EMEA, and APAC checklists. Ops Compliance also complete a Daily Checks (/tardis-oc-dailychecks) that is completed one time per day and is not region specific.
